gloss: verbal message; word left with someone

definitions.gloss: verbal message; message left with someone; errand
definitions.explanation: A message entrusted to someone to pass along to a third party. Can also refer to sending something via another person.

examples.japanese: {言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could I leave a message with you?

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I passed along a message from my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: They were out, so I left a message with a colleague and went home.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({言付|ことづ}ける). Also written as {託|ことづ}け. The verb form {言付|ことづ}ける means to entrust a message to someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask someone to pass a message)
- {言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to relay a message)
- {言付|ことづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧ (to take a message)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝言|でんごん}→伝言：03448_dengon⟧: message — more general, also used for written messages
- ⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧: message — the English loanword, broader in usage
